info.name: StudySlot API
info.description:
Full backend checkpoint for StudySlot (Step 21).

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order. Request 1 creates unique test users and real future time slots, so the collection can be run repeatedly.

Secrets: none are stored here. Tokens are captured at run time into collection variables. Don't re-export this collection with a run's variables filled in.

AI requests are added in Step 31.

exec: // ===== Run setup: unique test users and real future time slots =====
// Runs once at the start of the collection. Everything is created fresh each run,
// so the collection can be run again and again.
// `hour`:00 Eastern Time on the date `daysAhead` days from now (works in EDT and EST).
const base = new Date(Date.now() + daysAhead * DAY);
const candidate = new Date(Date.UTC(base.getUTCFullYear(), base.getUTCMonth(), base.getUTCDate(), hour + offset));
if (Number(eastern(candidate, { hour: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23' })) === hour) return candidate;
throw new Error('Could not compute an Eastern Time slot');
// A random Mon-Thu 3-40 days ahead (random so repeated runs rarely collide).
const slot2 = easternSlot(day + 1, 17);   // next weekday, 5:00 PM ET
const slot2Overlap = new Date(slot2.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000); // 5:30 PM, overlaps slot2
console.log('Test run', runId, { slot1: slot1.toISOString(), slot2: slot2.toISOString(), sunday: sunday.toISOString() });
